source_summary: Vertical monochrome ink landscape with layered rocky mountains, sparse winter trees, a small lower-left pavilion, distant shore elements, foreground rocks, reeds, and water. Calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from motifs.

motifs.name: left_sheer_peak
motifs.description: Isolate the tall left peak of the central mountain mass, including its vertical cliff face, rounded summit, sparse dark shrubs along the crest, pale ink washes, and dry-brush contour lines. Exclude the adjacent right peak and all inscription/seal areas.

motifs.name: central_rounded_peak
motifs.description: Isolate the rounded central-right mountain peak and ravine face beneath it, including the darker cleft, sloping shoulder, scrub textures, and layered wash. Avoid calligraphy and red seals above/right.

motifs.name: distant_left_shore_hamlet
motifs.description: Isolate the faint left middle-distance shoreline with low hills, tiny huts or walls, sparse trees, scattered rocks, and horizontal water-edge strokes.

motifs.name: middle_terraced_rocks
motifs.description: Isolate the midground layered rocky terrace below the peaks, with rounded boulders, path-like slopes, small bare trees, scrub patches, and soft ink-wash depressions.

motifs.name: right_pine_rock_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the right midground grove on rocks: angular boulders, a dark-needled pine, bare companion trees, small shrubs, and faint grasses near the slope.

motifs.name: foreground_tree_pavilion_group
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left foreground group where a small pavilion or house sits partly behind tall leafless and willow-like trees, including the roofline, support posts, trunks, bending branches, and nearby rock base.

motifs.name: central_winter_tree_stand
motifs.description: Isolate the central foreground stand of bare winter trees and sparse pines rising from the rocky slope, including tall trunks, branch networks, dark needle tufts, and grass-like brush marks.

motifs.name: lower_right_stream_reed_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right water margin with dark horizontal stream strokes, low grasses, reeds, pebbles, and the curving bank. Exclude nearby red seals and border areas.

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
